evf.pair.check.heading: Connection checks
evf.pair.check.https_fix: Foundry is not served over HTTPS: the Even Realities App will not load the glasses app. Put Foundry behind a valid certificate (reverse proxy, Tailscale or native TLS).
evf.pair.check.publicHost_fix: You opened Foundry from localhost: the QR would point the phone at itself. Reopen Foundry from the address the phone uses, then generate the QR.
evf.pair.check.served_fix: The glasses app is not reachable under /modules/evenfoundryvtt/g2/. Make sure the module is installed and enabled, and that your proxy forwards /modules.
evf.pair.check.socket_fix: The Foundry socket is disconnected. Reload Foundry; behind a proxy, make sure the WebSocket upgrade is forwarded.
